title: One judge's scores for one round of the home-page variations
description: One file per judge per round, named <judge>.json, in the directory given to scripts/variations-publish.ts as --judging. Every subject the judge saw gets a score from 1 to 10, in steps of 0.5, in each of the eight categories, and notes.

judge.description: Who judged, as a short name that stays the same from round to round, e.g. opus-5.5 or astra-6.2.

subjects.description: One entry per subject judged, each subject once.

subject.description: A design, v1 to v9, or a reference site as ref:<host>, e.g. ref:vercel.com.

first_ten_seconds.description: First ten seconds: does a newcomer know what this is, who it is for and why to trust it?

numbers.description: The numbers: can exact figures be read, scanned and compared?

trust_and_provenance.description: Trust and provenance: are freshness, Run counts, method and evidence visible without clutter?

agents_and_developers.description: The way in for agents and developers.

colour_and_contrast.description: Colour and contrast, in light and in dark.

notes.description: Free text: what works, what does not, what to change first. Read by the worker who improves the design.
